Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a high-fidelity screenshot-style design proposal for the Salasel personal learning app's new Notes management page. This is a real product UI, NOT a marketing landing page. Use supplied screenshot as incumbent visual authority: same flat navy #0f172a background, slate #1e293b header/panels, #334155 thin borders, off-white text, muted slate secondary text, teal #0d9488 active accents, 8-12px radii, existing compact sans typography with clear native Arabic shaping. Use supplied brand-mark image exactly as small existing logo, not redesigned. Render one SINGLE focused screen per image, horizontal 16:10 canvas, no collage, no captions outside UI, no browser chrome, no perspective devices, no decorative illustrations, no gradients, no new dashboard metrics. Strong reading contrast and generous comfortable line-height. Practical 44px controls. One plain-text document per video, no rich-text toolbar, no arbitrary notebooks, no account/cloud sync. Maintain playlist→video hierarchy, one canonical note per video. Text is synthetic sample content for design review, not user data.
Header: brand at far right in RTL or far left in English, center three navigation links Series/Podcasts/Notes, Notes active with thin teal underline, opposite side compact language control. Body begins ~100px from top with compact page heading and useful single-line explanation. Editor content must be legible and main task clear.
Religious image constraint: do not generate humans, animals, faces, characters, mascots, dolls, statues, tiny figures, thumbnails or decorative artwork depicting living beings. Existing supplied logo is allowed. Use only text, interface controls and abstract line icons. Do not copy people/thumbnails from screenshot reference.
Screen 1/6: Arabic RTL desktop Notes browse/read/edit workspace. Render single full app viewport ~1440x960 with header, centered max-width 1216 content. Top right title "ملاحظاتي", subtitle "كل ملاحظاتك، مرتبة حسب السلسلة والمقطع". Top left one restrained teal button "+ إضافة ملاحظة". Below title place wide search field "ابحث في السلاسل والمقاطع والملاحظات…". Main workspace: right-side 350px navigable collection tree with subtle slate surface; LEFT large 820px plain-text editor, separated by 24px gap. The right panel has heading "السلاسل والمقاطع". First playlist expanded "تذوق العبادات" with small "مقطعان بهما ملاحظات", actions overflow, selected row with subtle teal fill and right teal rail "١. معنى العبادة" and below muted last edited "آخر تعديل: اليوم". Next indented row "٢. حضور القلب" with one short note preview. Second collapsed playlist "مع نفسي" with "٣ مقاطع بها ملاحظات". Separate heading "مقاطع مستقلة" with row "حسن الظن بالله". All sections plain list rows, no thumbnail imagery, no nested card spam.
Left editor top breadcrumb "تذوق العبادات / معنى العبادة", clear heading "معنى العبادة", small line "آخر تعديل: اليوم، ١٠:٣٠ ص". Toolbar clear text actions "فتح المقطع" and "تصدير Markdown", secondary overflow. Right-aligned small teal check with "تم الحفظ" in editor header. Large calm text area contains 3 short separated paragraphs with natural Arabic: "العبادة تشمل أعمال القلب والجوارح." then "أراجع نيتي قبل العمل، وأربط ما أتعلمه بخطوة عملية في يومي." then "للمراجعة: ما الذي يعينني على حضور القلب؟". Plenty blank writing space, subtle label "ملاحظات المقطع". Page footer hint "تُحفظ الملاحظات في هذا المتصفح". Exact UI Arabic text must be sharp and correctly joined.
